_about: The linux-lts build's packages (doc/release_channels.md): for each package of ours in autobuild.xml, the linux64-lts archive (built in ubuntu:24.04, glibc 2.39 at most) of the release whose linux64 archive (built on ubuntu-26.04) autobuild.xml names, at the same version. scripts/ci_autobuild_override.py applies it in the linux-lts job only; scripts/tests/test_linux_lts_packages.py checks that it follows autobuild.xml. Update it with every package update.

without_lts.mesazink: No CI build installs it: CI configures with USE_MESAZINK off (Zink withdrawn), and MesaZink.cmake installs the package only with USE_MESAZINK on.
